dialect.detail: IBM mainframe-style COBOL with RECORDING MODE IS F, BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS, LABEL RECORDS ARE STANDARD, and GOBACK; likely compiled with IBM Enterprise COBOL or similar. Source contains a git merge conflict marker (<<<<<<< HEAD / =======) indicating collaborative student work.

purpose.domain_detail: Automotive parts supplier data processing — validates and processes parts, supplier addresses, and purchase orders for vehicle manufacturers (Chrysler, Ford, GM, Volkswagen, Toyota, Jaguar, Peugeot, BMW)
purpose.summary: FINALEX is a batch COBOL program that reads a PARTSUPPIN file containing part-supplier-address-purchase-order records and a STATEZIP reference file, validates the data by calling subprograms PARTEDIT and ADDREDIT, and writes error records to an ERRORFILE. It loads a state/zip code table at startup and processes each input record through edit checks.

notable_features: COPY copybooks (PARTS, PARTSUB, PRCHSORD, SUPADDRS, SUPPLIER, ERRORS, STATEZIP)
CALL to external subprograms PARTEDIT and ADDREDIT
OCCURS 3 TIMES INDEXED BY for address and purchase order arrays
88-level condition names for vehicle makes and supplier types
Git merge conflict markers present in source (<<<<<<< HEAD / =======)
COMP field workaround with auxiliary variable WS-WEEKS-LEAD-AUX
